For most of the war, Iran had an invaluable cushion: dozens of oil tankers holding millions of barrels of crude sitting safely in waters in Asia. Tehran steadily sold the oil to China, bringing in billions of much-needed cash. Now, that floating storage is gone. By mid-October, the reserves were fully depleted, according to analysts at Kpler, as a U.S. naval blockade prevented Iran from replacing the crude it normally sells to Chinese refineries. WSJ

The US ordered some diplomats and their families to leave Saudi Arabia because of the threat from Houthi militants, as the Iran-backed group carried out more strikes from Yemen; four people were killed in two attacks on an Aramco oil field and an airport in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. BBG

قالَ تعالى: {فَمَنِ اعْتَدَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدَى عَلَيْكُمْ} صدقَ اللهُ العظيم

شنَّ العدوُّ السعوديُّ المجرمُ خلالَ عدوانِه وتصعيدِه الأخيرِ منذُ 100 يومٍ أكثرَ من 2900 غارةٍ جويةٍ وصاروخٍ استهدفَ بها الأعيانَ المدنيةَ في بلدِنا العزيزِ ومرتکبًا من خلالِها عشراتِ الجرائمِ مخلفًا بذلك أكثرَ من 562 شهيدًا وجريحًا جلُّهم من النساءِ والأطفالِ
وفي إطارِ الردِّ على هذا العدوانِ والتصعيدِ الكبيرِ على بلدِنا وشعبِنا نفذتِ القواتُ المسلحةُ اليمنيةُ خلالَ الـ48 ساعةً الماضيةَ أربعَ عملياتٍ عسكريةً نوعيةً وذلك بعددٍ من الصواريخِ الباليستيةِ والطائراتِ المسيرةِ
الأولى استهدفت مبنى وزارةِ الدفاعِ في عاصمةِ العدوِّ السعوديِّ الرياضِ وكانتِ الإصابةُ مباشرةً بفضلِ اللهِ.
الثانيةُ استهدفت مطارَ فهدٍ الدوليَّ بالدمامِ وأدت إلى تعطلِ حركةِ الملاحةِ في المطارِ.
الثالثةُ استهدفت شركةَ أرامكو في ينبعَ وكانتِ الإصابةُ مباشرةً بفضلِ اللهِ وأدت إلى نشوبِ حريقٍ في الموقعِ المستهدفِ.

posts.text:
BEN HOROWITZ SAYS AMAZON $AMZN CEO ANDY JASSY TOLD HIM AI SUPPLY IS SOLD OUT BEYOND 2028

"I said, yeah, like we're out of everything till 2028. He's like, oh, it's beyond 2028."

Then he explained why that makes AI nothing like the dot-com bubble

"In the internet bubble, we didn't have enough demand because we had to build the internet. People had to get broadband. Originally they had to get their browser at Fry's. There weren't enough consumers on the internet to absorb all the bandwidth that had gotten built out."

"The lack of demand killed it. We don't really have a lack of demand in AI, so I think the dynamics will be different."

He did flag one risk. "If you get into a pathological debt situation, that can wreck anybody."

He said that's why Andreessen Horowitz isn't invested in any of the neoclouds. "That whole thing scares me, having been through it."

ON THIS DAY IN 1879, THOMAS EDISON CREATED THE FIRST PRACTICAL, LONG-LASTING LIGHT BULB

For months, his bulbs had burned out after just a few hours. His platinum filament kept melting.

The fix came while he was idly rolling a piece of carbon between his fingers. It gave him an idea: turn other materials into carbon and use them as the filament.

He tried a carbonized cotton thread inside a glass vacuum bulb, and it gave off a soft orange glow.

It burned for about 15 hours.
